name: After § 26
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2023
part_text: 26a. Notes that the absence of disaggregated regional and sectoral data on the VAT gap prevents the identification of the areas most at risk of fraud and evasion; calls on the Commission to introduce a harmonised system for the measurement of the VAT gap that includes territorial and sectoral dimensions, thereby enabling the development of anti-fraud strategies that are more firmly grounded in evidence and more targeted;
